designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1944 as a resting and wintering area for waterfowl in the bottomland hardwood swamp of southeast Missouri.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Mingo National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1944 under the authority of the Migratory Bird Treaty Act as a resting and wintering area for waterfowl and other migratory birds, and for the preservation of bottomland hardwood forest.
